paper.title: RoboSimStudio: An Interactive Toolkit for Human and Agent Rapid Real2Sim of Robot Manipulation Tasks
paper.data: Observed real robot interactions, editable Newton simulations, visual and force-feedback traces, and agentic Real2Sim2Real case studies.
paper.method: An interactive toolkit exposes solver, contact-model, and physical-parameter choices to humans and coding agents for iterative simulation refinement.
paper.task: Rapidly build and calibrate manipulation simulations from observed physical behavior.
paper.novelty: Makes contact modeling and physical parameter revision explicit, editable, and agent-operable rather than hiding them in a one-shot real-to-sim pipeline.
paper.project_relevance: Directly informs editable PhysicsConfig, ContactModel, ForceTrace, SimCalibration, and Real2Sim2Real validation fields.

paper.title: AutoRSR: Automated Real-to-Sim-to-Real Data Generation for Scalable Robot Learning
paper.data: Multi-view workspace observations, robot states, open-vocabulary queries, reference motions, and 1K generated episodes per task across three real tasks.
paper.method: Reconstructs metric workspaces, extracts object assets, registers scenes to the robot frame, and scales reference motions with interpolation and domain randomization.
paper.task: Convert scanned real workspaces into executable simulation assets and transferable manipulation data.
paper.novelty: Automates object extraction, metric scene registration, trajectory generation, and sim-to-real data scaling in one pipeline.
paper.project_relevance: Useful for MetricScene, RobotFrameRegistration, ExecutableAsset, ReferenceMotion, and sim-to-real dataset contracts.

paper.title: PhySGA: A Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for Generalizable and Interactive 3D Composition
paper.data: Isaac Sim composition tasks spanning rigid, articulated, and deformable objects with hanging, settling, alignment, and containment relations.
paper.method: Assembly and critic agents plan and diagnose simulator states; action routers execute physical primitives and a self-evolving skill library reuses successful corrections.
paper.task: Interactively assemble physically plausible 3D object compositions in simulation.
paper.novelty: Grounds agentic 3D composition in closed-loop contact dynamics and executable simulator actions rather than static coordinate prediction.
paper.project_relevance: Direct reference for AssemblyPlan, ContactDiagnosis, ActionPrimitive, SkillLibrary, PhysicalRelation, and scene validators.

paper.title: From Failures to Learnable Worlds: Policy-Conditioned Environment Generation for Navigation Agents
paper.data: ProcTHOR diagnostic rollouts and generated navigation environments, evaluated with three agents and transfer to HM3D.
paper.method: WEDGE contrasts successful and failed rollouts, validates executable weakness features, maps them to controllable environment factors, and regenerates targeted training worlds.
paper.task: Generate policy-specific navigation environments that target verified failure modes.
paper.novelty: Uses an agent's measured weaknesses—not generic realism or difficulty—to drive environment generation and iterative adaptation.
paper.project_relevance: Useful for FailureFeature, EnvironmentFactor, GeneratorControl, DiagnosticSplit, and targeted curriculum generation.

paper.title: PAWA: Panoramic Action-conditioned World Modeling for Multiple Agents
paper.data: Synchronized Minecraft player POV videos, world-stabilized panoramic videos, and aligned actions, captured with a pipeline scaling beyond 64 players.
paper.method: A dual-tower POV/panorama predictor uses cross-attention in a shared world frame and quadratic-phase player encodings.
paper.task: Predict action-conditioned shared-world evolution for multiple independently acting players.
paper.novelty: Introduces panoramic shared state and aligned multiplayer action data for scalable multi-agent world modeling.
paper.project_relevance: Direct source for SharedWorldFrame, PlayerAction, PanoramaState, ConcurrentAgent, and multiplayer consistency evaluation.

paper.title: DeSpatial: The devil of Agentic Spatial Reasoning Lies in 3D Itself
paper.data: VSI-Bench, MindCube-Tiny, ViewSpatial, and VSI-SUPER object-centric spatial reasoning tasks.
paper.method: A shared metric gravity-aligned 3D perception tool co-refines segmentation/depth and fuses instances across views before tool-based reasoning.
paper.task: Build reliable unified 3D scenes for agentic spatial question answering.
paper.novelty: Diagnoses perception as the dominant bottleneck and separates scene reconciliation from downstream reasoning tools.
paper.project_relevance: Provides UnifiedScene, GravityFrame, InstanceFusion, ProjectionArtifact, and perception-oracle diagnostic fields.

paper.title: DynThinker: Unifying Static 3D and Dynamic 4D Spatial Reasoning
paper.data: Nine static-3D and dynamic-4D benchmarks summarized by ten metrics, including ReVSI, DSR-Bench, and DSI-Bench.
paper.method: Decoupled EMA constrains interference-sensitive parameter groups while Spatial-Dynamic Fusion injects geometry-encoder priors under semantic guidance.
paper.task: Jointly improve static 3D and dynamic 4D spatial reasoning in one model.
paper.novelty: Targets non-uniform spatial-dynamic interference at parameter-group level instead of training separate static and dynamic models.
paper.project_relevance: Useful for Static3D, Dynamic4D, TemporalGeometry, InterferenceAudit, and unified spatial-evaluation design.

paper.title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
paper.data: Seven simulated settings and four real robotic tasks varying latent physical properties and environment rules.
paper.method: Alternates world-model and environment-latent optimization during training, then adapts a new compact latent from one or more test interactions while freezing the model.
paper.task: Adapt action-conditioned world predictions and control to unseen environment dynamics at test time.
paper.novelty: Infers unsupervised environment factors such as friction, mass, and rules through test-time latent optimization.
paper.project_relevance: Direct reference for EnvironmentLatent, HiddenPhysicalProperty, TestInteraction, OnlineAdaptation, and action-conditioned dynamics.

paper.title: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling
paper.data: Waymo training/evaluation with zero-shot transfer to KITTI and nuScenes.
paper.method: A scene tokenizer aggregates geometry-foundation-model features into view-decoupled state; a ray-query decoder and autoregressive model separate scene dynamics from camera motion.
paper.task: Predict metric 3D scene-state evolution and query it from arbitrary cameras.
paper.novelty: Decouples predictive geometry state from viewpoint while preserving one context-derived scale over rollout.
paper.project_relevance: Provides ViewDecoupledState, CameraMotion, MetricScale, RayQuery, and cross-view rollout interfaces.

paper.title: OneWM: Can World and Action Modeling Benefit Each Other under Unified Causal Training?
paper.data: LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboCasa365, and real-world manipulation rollouts.
paper.method: A shared causal video-action architecture treats actions as both world-prediction conditions and policy targets.
paper.task: Jointly learn action-conditioned world prediction and robot action generation.
paper.novelty: Provides controlled evidence that forward modeling improves policies and action learning improves multi-view world prediction in the same architecture.
paper.project_relevance: Direct baseline for UnifiedCausalTraining, ActionCondition, WorldTarget, PolicyTarget, and reciprocal-benefit ablations.

paper.title: What Matters for World Modeling in Vision-Language-Action Models?
paper.data: In-domain, OOD, long-horizon, dynamic, few-shot, and real-world evaluations over multiple policy backbones.
paper.method: Instantiates four world-model integration paradigms under a unified framework and crosses them with different future representations and policy backbones.
paper.task: Identify which world representations and integration patterns reliably improve VLA control.
paper.novelty: Separates representation, integration paradigm, and backbone effects that prior systems change simultaneously.
paper.project_relevance: A direct design/evaluation map for FutureRepresentation, IntegrationParadigm, PolicyBackbone, and long-horizon/OOD tests.

paper.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
paper.data: 312 tasks in five suites, 37 single and 18 paired preferences, and 40.8K demonstrations with task, preference, simulator-state, and per-step metadata.
paper.method: A procedural LIBERO pipeline generates preference-ready scenes, paired preferred/non-preferred demonstrations, and explicit satisfaction metrics for motion, skill, and user-profile preferences.
paper.task: Evaluate zero-shot, learned, generalized, composed, and conflicting preferences separately from task completion.
paper.novelty: Separates robotic task success from how a user wants the task performed with reusable, automatically scored preference variables.
paper.project_relevance: Adds Preference, SatisfactionMetric, Conflict, Composition, UserProfile, and personalized manipulation evaluation fields.

paper.title: Orbia: Do Generated Videos Form a Consistent 3D World?
paper.data: 720 indoor/outdoor exploration cases, six exploration-and-revisit protocols, and evaluations of 27 text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models.
paper.method: Measures input preservation, generated-content persistence, and 3D self-consistency using registered RGB-D anchors, revisit comparisons, cross-view geometry, scale, and held-out rendering.
paper.task: Benchmark whether interactive video generators preserve one consistent 3D world across exploration and revisits.
paper.novelty: Systematically tests newly generated regions for persistence as well as cross-view geometric agreement and minute-long return consistency.
paper.project_relevance: Direct validator for Persistence, Revisit, InputPreservation, CrossViewDepth, RegionalScale, and held-out reconstruction.

paper.title: ForceBench: Benchmarking Force Integration for Robotic Manipulation
paper.data: Eight tasks, 1,600 synchronized demonstrations, six-axis wrist force, seven integration designs, and five real-world tasks.
paper.method: Controls backbone, demonstrations, task criteria, and evaluation protocol to isolate visual-force fusion design choices.
paper.task: Benchmark how force observations should be integrated into VLA policies for physical-property, resistance, and assembly tasks.
paper.novelty: Provides a unified protocol that separates force-fusion architecture effects from task and control differences.
paper.project_relevance: Adds ForceObservation, FusionDesign, Resistance, ContactAssembly, and sim/real force-integration evaluation fields.

paper.title: TacClaw-Infinity: A Large-Scale Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Dexterous Manipulation
paper.data: Over 10,000 hours, one million episodes, and one billion frames across more than 1,000 tasks, with synchronized vision, fingertip tactile, language, and actions.
paper.method: A tactile UMI-style handheld interface plus distributed collection, trajectory reconstruction, embodiment-aware filtering, quality control, and structured contact/spatial annotation.
paper.task: Scale contact-rich VTLA demonstrations and test cross-embodiment dexterous transfer.
paper.novelty: Combines unprecedented VTLA scale with contact segmentation, subtasks, spatial grounding, and collection independent of the target robot.
paper.project_relevance: Direct source for VisionTactileLanguageAction, ContactSegment, QualityFilter, EmbodimentMap, and large-scale manipulation data schemas.

paper.title: Active Generative Simulation: Meta-Learning What to Simulate for Sim-and-Real Policy Co-Training
paper.data: Simulation parameter spaces, limited real demonstrations, generated skill/object-receptacle combinations, and real manipulation evaluations.
paper.method: MetaGenSim trains a rater by meta-gradients to select simulator generation distributions that maximize downstream real-policy performance.
paper.task: Optimize what simulation data to generate for sim-and-real co-training.
paper.novelty: Turns simulator data generation into a downstream-performance optimization problem rather than uniform sampling or manual alignment.
paper.project_relevance: Useful for GeneratorDistribution, UtilityRater, SimRealAlignment, SkillStitching, and data-curriculum infrastructure.
